It is unlocked at {{Coll|Blaze Slayer VI}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Blaze Slayer 6}} |A1 = |B1 = Enchanted Sulphur Cube, 16 |C1 = |A2 = |B2 = Molten Powder, 64 |C2 = |A3 = Inferno Vertex, 8 |B3 = Mawdredge Dagger |C3 = Inferno Vertex, 8 |Output = Deathripper Dagger }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |name = Deathripper Dagger |rarity = l |damage = 160 |crit_chance = 10 |crit_damage = 25 |attack_speed = 20 |strength = 75 |special_effect = Deal {{Red|3.5x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs.
Deal {{Red|2x}} damage to {{mt|Skeletal}} mobs.
Gain {{stat|combat wisdom|+45}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. |item_ability_name = Attunement |item_ability_description = Swap between {{White|Spirit}} and {{Cyan|Crystal}} mode in order to attack through Hellion Shields. |item_ability_activation = On Right Click |item_ability_name2 = Wraith Drain |item_ability_description2 = On hit, heal for {{Red|200}} + {{Red|4%}}{{HP}} after {{Green|6s}} if the Hellion Shield has switched attunement. }} The '''Deathripper Dagger''' deals {{Red|3.5x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs and {{Red|2x}} damage to {{mt|Skeletal}} mobs. Additionally, it provides {{Stat|combat wisdom|+45}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. The '''Deathripper Dagger''' has {{Green|2}} abilities: * {{AN|Attunement}} allows the wielder to swap between '''Spirit''' and {{Aqua|'''Crystal'''}} attunements in order to attack through the {{MobSprite|Inferno Demonlord}}'s {{AN|Hellion Shield}} ability. When switching attunement, the '''Deathripper Dagger''' changes appearance from a {{Item|Iron Sword|link=}} to a {{Item|Golden Sword|link=}}. * {{AN|Wraith Drain}} allows the wielder to heal {{Stat|hp|200}} + {{Stat|hp|4%|icononly=yes}} after {{Green|6s}} upon hit if the {{AN|Hellion Shield}} has switched attunement. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/Mar 21|link=none|[[File:Deathripper Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Deathripper Dagger'''.}} {{History|2024/Nov 25|link=none|'''Deathripper Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+45}} against Blazes.}} {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Deathripper Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Deathripper Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Deathripper Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Deathripper Dagger'''.}} {{History|0.20.9|'''Deathripper Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+45}} against Blazes.}} {{History|0.23.3|'''Deathripper Dagger''' perks changed to affect {{mt|Infernal}} and {{mt|Wither}} mobs.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Deathripper Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Deathripper Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Blaze}} [[Category:Daggers]]
